is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii) in Togo.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (L1014F), Vgsc L995S (L1014S), Vgsc N1575Y (N1575Y), and Ace-1 G119S (G280S).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 provides sample sizes (N) and allelic frequencies for L1014F, L1014S, N1575Y, and G119S for both An. coluzzii and An. gambiae s.s. across the study sites.

african_field_population.evidence: The study collected field-caught indoor-resting female Anopheles mosquitoes from three rural sites in Togo.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an original empirical research article reporting new field data.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study provides specific locations (Kovié, Nangbéto, Mango) and geographic coordinates in Table 1.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study reports collection dates from December 2013 to April 2015, which is within a 3-year window.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes new field collections conducted between 2013 and 2015.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including sample sizes and allele frequencies, are provided in the main text tables (Table 2).

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from three rural sites in Togo. It reports the presence of kdr mutations (L1014F, L1014S, N1575Y) and the Ace-1 G119S mutation, providing allele frequencies for both An. gambiae s.s. and An. coluzzii.
